facts.claim: Vision of the Seas (Royal Caribbean): Entered service 1998; 78,450 GT; 2000 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Vision class.
Award Winning family cruise ship Vision of the Seas provides the perfect blend of the most beautiful family friendly cultural destinations, world-class dining and epic activities.
Vision of the Seas is a Vision-class cruise ship operated by Royal Caribbean International, the last of her class.

catalogSpecs.description: Vision-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 1998; 78,450 GT; approx. 2,000 guests at double occupancy.
